Dolly Parton nephew accuses manager of bad faith after security firing Following Dolly Parton's August 25 death, her nephew Bryan Seaver, longtime head of security for her properties, was terminated and replaced by a new security team across the Nashville home, museum, and warehouse, with the estate said to be overseen by the DP Dean Trust. Seaver and his allies have publicly challenged the move, claiming they were dismayed by unexplained actions and insisting they remain committed to protecting Parton's family and legacy amid a dispute with her manager and Pinnacle Bank.
